sources.title: MoE2-LoRA: When MoE Models Meet MoE-style Low-Rank Adaptation
sources.snippet: These observations naturally raise a unifying question: When MoE models meet MoE-style low-rank adaptation, how can we deeply bind the two MoE mechanisms at both the MoE module level and the MoE model level, thereby enhancing task performance while preserving general capabilities?
